hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched from off to on, and the newly enabled code path in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py raises ZeroDivisionError on account page requests. Errors begin in the exact minute the flag starts evaluating 'on' (15:16, 59 off / 141 on - a partial rollout) and stay ~21-36% while the flag reads 'on'.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
Preceding minutes show 'monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations' with only sporadic 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' errors at 0-2%
error_rate jumps from 0.01 at 15:15 to 0.21 at 15:16 and stays 0.26-0.355 thereafter
flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: admin)
The only recorded changes to io-shop from 2026-09-09T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-16T15:30:00Z are three monthly-spend-feature toggles - no deployments at all

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Same cause, but the reason the attempted remediation failed is that the flag was never actually left off: the change log records Argus switching monthly-spend-feature ON again at 15:24:49, and every log minute through 15:25 still reads 'monthly-spend-feature=on'. Re-disabling the flag and confirming the log line reads 'off - 200 evaluations' should clear the ZeroDivisionErrors.

supporting_evidence.claim: flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched off (actor: Argus)
flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: Argus)

hypotheses.summary: A latent defect in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py shipped earlier and was merely exposed by the flag; no deployment is visible in the change record for the week before the incident, so a bad release cannot be confirmed from this evidence. To distinguish it I would need a deploy/release record for io-shop covering the code in spend_summary.py.
